- **Verdict: CHANGES REQUIRED** — the contract content passes; the two red required checks are caused by this diff (F1).
- **Head reviewed:** `1c03409a19a8e505b7dec03029321581f712f5eb` (matches the `1c03409a19` prefix; merge-base `b6d07df4b`, `origin/main` has not moved past it).
- **Clause-② reading:** **yes** — seven optional members on the published `@object-ui/types` `.d.ts` narrow from `string`/`string[]`/`boolean`/`number` to `never`, and `@object-ui/plugin-ai`'s runtime registration metadata (`ComponentRegistry.getMeta(type).inputs`) loses seven entries. The PR body's `Clause-②: yes` is correct and complete (names both packages; the card's claim comment carries the same reading).
- **Governed surface:** none — `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test <all 9 changed paths>` → `NOT GOVERNED`.

## CI on head

| check | cause | caused by this diff |
|---|---|---|
| `Type Check` (job 102403772050) | step 7 `node scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` exit 1: "`@object-ui/plugin-ai` has 2 test files that no `tsc` invocation reads … Unread: `src/AIRecommendations.rendersEveryItem-8178.test.tsx`, `src/registrationInputs-8178.test.ts`". `packages/plugin-ai/tsconfig.json:24-31` excludes `**/*.test.ts(x)` (correctly, build config) and `packages/plugin-ai/package.json` `"type-check": "tsc --noEmit"` chains no `tsconfig.test.json`. Steps 8-29 (incl. `Run type-check`) were skipped. | **yes** — plugin-ai had zero test files on `main`; these are its first. |
| `Test (shard 4/4)` (job 102403772038) | `scripts/__tests__/check-type-check-coverage.test.ts:823` — `AssertionError: expected [ '@object-ui/plugin-ai' ] to deeply equal []` (the same invariant pinned as a vitest test). 705/706 files passed; this is the only failure. | **yes** — same root cause. |

## Findings

**F1 — blocking** — `packages/plugin-ai/package.json` (`scripts.type-check`) + missing `packages/plugin-ai/tsconfig.test.json`. The PR adds the package's first two test files but no `tsc` program reads them; both red checks are this one gap. Fix: add `packages/plugin-ai/tsconfig.test.json` modelled on `packages/plugin-kanban/tsconfig.test.json` (`extends ../../tsconfig.json`, `noEmit: true`, `composite: false`, `"types": ["node"]` — needed for the `node:fs`/`node:path`/`node:url` reads in `registrationInputs-8178.test.ts`; `@types/node` is already a plugin-ai devDependency; jest-dom is not needed, the tests use only core matchers — `"paths": {}`, `include: ["src/**/*.test.ts", "src/**/*.test.tsx"]`) and chain it: `"type-check": "tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json"`. Then actually run `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-ai run type-check` after `turbo run build --filter '@object-ui/plugin-ai...'`: these two tests have never been compiled by any `tsc` (the PR body's "plugin-ai type-check exit 0" reads a program that excludes them), so real errors may surface. `package.json` `scripts` is not one of the eight published-contract fields, so no changeset change is owed for the fix.

No other findings.

## Published-face delta (all named in the changeset)

- `packages/types/src/ai.ts:121` `formId?: never`, `:133` `objectName?: never`, `:143` `fields?: never`, `:169` `autoFill?: never` (`AIFormAssistSchema`); `:255` `objectName?: never`, `:287` `maxResults?: never` (`AIRecommendationsSchema`); `:384` `objectName?: never` (`NLQuerySchema`). Each carries `@deprecated Not part of this contract — the value was inert.` — the exact tombstone convention already on `packages/types/src/complex.ts:172-174, 366-386`.
- `packages/plugin-ai/src/index.tsx`: seven `inputs` entries removed (old lines 24, 25, 26, 28 on `ai-form-assist`; 43, 45 on `ai-recommendations`; 65 on `nl-query`).
- `packages/plugin-ai/src/AIFormAssist.tsx`: dead `autoFill = false` destructure removed (old line 31). No behavioural change — the binding was never read.
- `packages/plugin-ai/README.md`: all teaching examples rewritten; new "What these components do not do" section with the migration table. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-ai.mdx` is a stub that defers to the README — nothing stale there. No zod mirror exists for the AI schemas (`packages/types/src/zod/` has none), so no zod delta is owed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope = card, exactly.** Card body table + ruling comment (2026-09-07) name seven members; the diff tombstones exactly those seven and nothing else (`AIInsightsSchema.objectName` untouched and pinned at `string | undefined`). "Five designer inputs" = five distinct names; the seven removed entries are the card's own citations (`index.tsx:24-30` ×4, `41-51` ×2, `60-65` ×1). "Renders every item" is pre-existing behaviour, not new: `origin/main` `AIRecommendations.tsx` has no `slice`/`maxResults` and already renders `recommendations.length` in the badge — the test pins what was already true.
- **Dead-code claim re-verified on `origin/main` with exact names:** `maxResults`/`autoFill` occur only at their declaration, designer input and the dead destructure; `objectName`/`fields`/`formId` inside `packages/plugin-ai/src` only in `index.tsx` inputs; the only `...` tokens in the package are two string-literal ellipses (no prop spread). Retirement, not regression.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/8178-ai-schemas-retire-zero-read-members.md` — `minor` for `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/plugin-ai`, both published (`private` unset, `files: [dist, README.md, …]`). Matches AGENTS.md L240 (never `major`; breaking scored `minor` with semantics in body) and the shape of `.changeset/8221-retire-legacy-string-sort.md`. Body is accurate on the published-face consequences (compile-time refusal; stored JSON still parses, value still ignored; designer no longer offers the keys). One precision nit, not a finding: `?: never` still admits an explicit `key: undefined`, so "a node that carries one is a compile-time error" means "with a value" — the test header says as much.
- **Tests pin the retirement, not implementation:** type-level `Equal<…, undefined>` ×7 (reddens on deletion too, since `BaseSchema`'s `[key: string]: any` at `base.ts:467` would make a deleted member read `any`), `@ts-expect-error` on fresh literals ×7, widened values ×3, wrong-typed value, plus the live "deleted row" control; registry absence with non-empty control and an exact live-inputs snapshot; 50-item render in both layouts with 3/0 controls. Root tsconfig does not set `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, so the `undefined` rows hold. No old-behaviour test was removed (plugin-ai had none).
- **Not yet CI-verified because of F1:** `Run type-check` never ran on this head, so `tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.test.json` — the ruling's compile-time pin — rests on the dev's local exit 0 until the fix reruns the job. `Doc Snippet Type Check`, `README Export Check`, `Lint` (`pnpm check`), `Build & E2E`, `Changeset *`, shards 1-3 are green on this head.
- **Process:** the PR body's gate table omits `pnpm type-check:coverage` (`scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`, which is `Type Check` step 7), and its vitest evidence covered only the three new files, not `scripts/__tests__/`. Convergence-period red → patch round to the same dev, not REWORK.
- **ADR-0049** as cited is objectstack's `docs/adr/0049-no-unenforced-security-properties.md` (the enforce-or-remove gate); objectui's `docs/adr/` has no 0049. Five existing `packages/types/src/__tests__/*` files cite it the same way, so this is repo convention.
- **Carriers:** draft, base `main`, `Fixes #8178` (whole card executed → closing on merge is correct), `needs:contract-review` on both PR and card, `Clause-②: yes` on both. `content/docs/releases/` untouched; no file unrelated to the card.
